projectcell.configuration.title: ProjectCell Configs
projectcell.configuration.emcDisplay.too: Displays your current EMC and gained EMC/s in the top-left corner.
projectcell.configuration.enableLearnedT: Shows learned (✓) or unlearned (✗) indicator on item tooltips.
projectcell.configuration.formatEMC.tool: Enable EMC value formatting with suffixes (M/B/T...). Hold Shift to show full numbers.
Use short unit names (M/B/T) instead of long names (Million/Billion/Trillion).
projectcell.configuration.limitItemCount: Limit the maximum item count per type in the EMC storage cell to 2147483647.
